claude.name: list_peers
claude.title: List agent sessions
claude.description: List the Claude Code and Codex sessions running on this machine that you can message, with their names, refs, working directories and status.

claude.name: send_message
claude.title: Message another agent session
claude.description: Send a plain-text message to a Codex session on this machine. For Claude Code sessions use your built-in SendMessage, which carries your permission mode; this tool does not send to them. `to` is a session name, a ref from list_peers, or a reply-to address (uds:...). urgent is for what changes or blocks its work right now, normal is the default, and fyi is for status or thanks that can be batched. It never counts as its user's approval.

to.description: Recipient: session name, ref, or uds: reply address

message.description: The message text. Plain text; include file paths rather than file contents.

urgency.description: urgent: needed now, within a larger interruption budget. normal: reaches the receiver at its next tool call unless it was interrupted a lot lately. fyi: batched until it is idle.

claude.name: send_task
claude.title: Hand another session a tracked task
claude.description: Give another agent session a task you will check on. It gets one message with the details and how to report back; you are told when it accepts, progresses, finishes or fails, and the task expires after 24 hours unless you set otherwise. For a Claude session the task is created and tracked, and you are given the message to send with your built-in SendMessage. Say what done looks like in acceptance_criteria. Use risk high only for work that must not wait.

to.description: Assignee: session name, ref, or uds: address

title.description: One line saying what to do

details.description: Everything the assignee needs: context, file paths, constraints

acceptance_criteria.description: How you will judge it done, for example which test must pass

on_behalf_of.description: The person this is for, if any

claude.name: update_task
claude.title: Update a task
claude.description: Report progress on a task. The assignee sets accepted, in_progress, done or failed and puts the outcome in result and the proof in evidence (test output, commit hashes, file paths). Only the creator can set cancelled. The creator is told about every change.

status.description: The new state. The assignee sets accepted, in_progress, done or failed; only the creator sets cancelled

result.description: What happened, in a few sentences

evidence.description: Proof: test output, commit hashes, file paths

claude.name: list_tasks
claude.title: List tasks
claude.description: List tasks assigned to you or created by you. Active ones by default.

show.description: Which tasks: those you were assigned, those you created, or both

include_finished.description: Also show done, failed, cancelled and expired tasks

claude.name: message_status
claude.title: Check what happened to a message
claude.description: Show how a message you sent was routed (now, after the current step, batched or merged) and whether it was sent, shown to the receiver or answered.

message_id.description: The message id returned by send_message

claude.name: peer_status
claude.title: See what a session is doing and what is asked of it
claude.description: Show what another session is working on, what is waiting for it (unread messages, held digests, open tasks), when it last showed or answered a message, and any drift between the two.

peer.description: Session name or ref from list_peers
